title: PH, Japan lead maritime security, disaster response exercise in Subic

blocks.text: SUBIC, Zambales — The Philippines and Japan are bringing together naval forces from Southeast Asia and their partner countries here this week for a series of maritime activities focused on cooperation, disaster response and other shared challenges at sea. In a statement on Tuesday, the Philippine Navy said it formally opened on Monday the Joint Cooperative Activity (JCA) and Future Leaders’ Program (FLP) of the Asean Defence Ministers’ Meeting-Plus Experts’ Working Group on Maritime Security (ADMM-Plus EWG on MS), together with the Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force (JMSDF).
